overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures dehydrated raw banana powder from carefully selected unripe green bananas sourced in India. As an FSSAI-registered manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, we maintain a controlled six-step production process. The green bananas undergo washing, slicing, low-temperature dehydration, and precise milling. The resulting powder offers a uniform light cream color, smooth texture, and neutral flavor for reliable industrial applications.

Our raw banana powder features an 80 to 100 mesh size with moisture levels controlled below 8 percent. It maintains shelf stability for 24 months under proper dry storage conditions. We support international food processors, distributors, and brands with bulk supply and custom packaging. Full export documentation support and flexible order volumes streamline sourcing for global commercial manufacturing needs.
highlights: Manufactured from dehydrated mature green bananas
Uniform light cream to off-white appearance
Neutral and mildly starchy flavor profile
applications: Bakery formulations including breads and cookies
Thickening agent in soups and sauces

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for raw banana powder?
faqs.a: Our standard minimum order quantity is 5 kg, supporting both small commercial trials and high-volume container shipments.

faqs.q: What is the shelf life and recommended storage?
faqs.a: The shelf life is 24 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and moisture.

faqs.q: Do you offer OEM and private label packaging?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide full private label and OEM services, including small pouches, retail jars, and custom outer cartons.

faqs.q: Can we request product samples prior to bulk ordering?
faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available on request for quality assessment, bench testing, and recipe formulation.

faqs.q: Can the mesh size be customized for our formulation?
faqs.a: Our standard fineness is 80 to 100 mesh, but custom mesh sizes can be manufactured upon request to meet your process needs.

faqs.q: What export documentation support do you provide?
faqs.a: As an FSSAI-registered manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter, we handle comprehensive export documentation to ensure smooth customs clearance.
